        sort_keys=True,

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest


PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
PROGRAM = PROJECT_ROOT / "fingerprint.py"


class FingerprintTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def run_program(self, *arguments: object) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[bytes]:
        return subprocess.run(
            [sys.executable, str(PROGRAM), *(str(argument) for argument in arguments)],
            cwd=PROJECT_ROOT,
            stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
            stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
            check=False,
        )

    def assert_successful_fingerprint(self, data: bytes, expected_text: str) -> bytes:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary_directory:
            input_path = Path(temporary_directory) / "input.txt"
            input_path.write_bytes(data)
            result = self.run_program(input_path)

        expected_object = {
            "byte_count": len(data),
            "sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),
            "text": expected_text,
        }
        expected_output = (
            json.dumps(
                expected_object,
                ensure_ascii=False,
                sort_keys=True,
                separators=(",", ":"),
            ).encode("utf-8")
            + b"\n"
        )
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout, expected_output)
        self.assertEqual(result.stderr, b"")
        return result.stdout

    def test_ascii_input_has_exact_canonical_output_and_digest(self) -> None:
        self.assert_successful_fingerprint(b"hello\n", "hello\n")

    def test_unicode_input_has_exact_canonical_output_and_byte_digest(self) -> None:
        text = "Snowman: \u2603; caf\u00e9; \U0001f642\n"
        self.assert_successful_fingerprint(text.encode("utf-8"), text)

    def test_repeated_runs_are_byte_for_byte_identical(self) -> None:
        data = "repeat \u03bb\n".encode("utf-8")
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary_directory:
            input_path = Path(temporary_directory) / "input.txt"
            input_path.write_bytes(data)
            first = self.run_program(input_path)
            second = self.run_program(input_path)

        self.assertEqual(first.returncode, 0)
        self.assertEqual(second.returncode, 0)
        self.assertEqual(first.stdout, second.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(first.stderr, second.stderr)

    def test_empty_input_is_valid(self) -> None:
        self.assert_successful_fingerprint(b"", "")

    def test_exact_size_limit_is_valid(self) -> None:
        self.assert_successful_fingerprint(b"a" * 4096, "a" * 4096)

    def test_missing_argument_fails_without_stdout(self) -> None:
        result = self.run_program()
        self.assertNotEqual(result.returncode, 0)
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout, b"")
        self.assertIn(b"error:", result.stderr)

        result = self.run_program("one", "two")
